Vs.

full_judgment: 5. Mr Shaikh Forhadul Haque, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner has placed the revisional application, judgment and order of the courts below and submits that the learned revisional court below has committed of law error by allowing the revision and setting aside the judgment and order passed by the trial court which cannot be sustained in law. He further submits that the revisional court below has committed an error of law resulting in an error in the decisions occasioning failure of justice in not considering that the plaintiff filed the suit for declaration and that the deed in question is forged and not binding upon her and the burden of proof lies upon the plaintiff to prove the same as per provision of section 101 of the Evidence Act and, as such, it is necessary to call for the document and to get an expert opinion in order to prove her case. He lastly submits that revisional court below failed to consider that the plaintiff filed the application earlier on 31-8-2009 but the trial court passed the order to be considered after closing the evidence which is not latches on the part of the plaintiff-petitioner and, as such, he prayed for to make the rule absolute and set aside the judgment and order of the revisional court below. In support of his contention he has referred the decision reported in 45 DLR 169 and 8 BLC (AD) 158.
